value.rationale: The exact global two-input variation coefficient provides a natural worst-case noise/perturbation stability invariant for a classical unbiased rank filter; this is not its one-input smoothing factor. A genuine structural boundary effect emerges: full weighted nonexpansivity admits a twofold boundary taper while interior weights are rigid. This produces practical new admissible seminorm geometries (and exact equality inputs), and makes transparent why two individually expansive nonlinear morphology components may have a nonexpansive arithmetic mean. The all-length classification is motivated independently of its computed finite examples.
